_comment: A broken deep cavalry block rounds a hill in its line of flight with no man held against it. Team 1's 80 horses (default Cavalry geometry: 9 files by 9 ranks, about 320 wu wide and 960 wu deep) spawn ALREADY routing (starting_state 3, morale 1.0) facing south, their own back edge, with their front rank 220 wu short of a hill (block terrain, x 780-1040, y 1400-1600) that stands across the eastern half of the block; the block's centre line (x 820) passes 40 wu inside the hill's west face. Each man runs for his own back edge on his own (SoldierFlightStep); a man whose run would carry him onto the hill, within the distance he needs to stop, veers along its face toward the shorter way round (SoldierBodies.router_terrain_avoid), so the eastern files pour round the hill's west end rather than piling against it. The leading eastern riders reach the face and run along it: soldiers_at_block_terrain_edge (men within a body radius plus 1 wu of the hill) reads 4, 3 and 1 at ticks 240, 300 and 330, and 0 at tick 350, every man past the hill, none inside it at any declared tick. Measured with dense 2-tick FULL dumps on seeds 0 to 4 (identical: nothing here draws on the seed), 2026-11-13 on #1949's branch. The unit's position reads the men's centroid while they rout: (819.95, 706.47) at tick 8 (a setup pin: the spawn), (749.65, 975.05) at tick 240 and (711.24, 1190.75) at tick 330. The bottom-up flight (#1949) removed the anchor these pinned at (819.9, 700.4), (737.3, 939.3) and (645.4, 1153.1), and the unit-level detour that kept every man off the face, whose three soldiers_at_block_terrain_edge pins of 0 at ticks 240, 300 and 330 are retired for soldiers_in_block_terrain pins of 0 at the same ticks; the tick-350 pins of 0 men at the face and 0 inside it still hold, and fail for a man held on the face. A routing unit's rout timer (6 s) runs out at tick 360 and it rallies; the clip ends at tick 352, just before that, so it shows only the flight. A small idle team-0 squadron 600 wu east keeps the router in the close sim tier (an isolated block drops to the far tier, which has no bodies); all_teams_control leaves both sides without AI, so neither moves on its own. Flat declared map apart from the hill; drill mode. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd; world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
